description: Google OR-Tools for Python (Apache-2.0), providing the CP-SAT constraint solver. Installed system-wide with pip at image build time; nothing is fetched at run time.
verify: python3 -c "from ortools.sat.python import cp_model; m=cp_model.CpModel(); x=m.NewIntVar(0,5,'x'); m.Maximize(x); s=cp_model.CpSolver(); assert s.Solve(m)==cp_model.OPTIMAL; print('ok')"
